title_en: Why Fizz Is a Great Option for Phone Service Across Canada - IGN
body_en:
When you’re looking for a phone provider, all the details you need to think about can make your head spin. What’s different about each plan? How does data work? How long is the contract? Are there hidden fees? It’s enough to make you wish someone would come along and just take care of all that for you.
Well, Fizz pretty much does that. It removes all those headaches by allowing you to create a plan that’s tailored to you. There’s no sifting through several different preset options to try to figure out which one fits you best. You’ll decide exactly what your plan looks like, how much it costs, and you don’t have to lock yourself into a contract.
That flexibility without long-term commitment is a big reason why the company has grown in recent years, now offering network coverage across Canada. So if you’re thinking of switching providers, here are some of the primary reasons why you should consider Fizz.
Everyone’s lives and priorities are different, which means the things they need out of their mobile provider are different. Many providers offer levels of plans that can require you to pay for things you won’t actually use, but Fizz avoids that by letting you create your own plan .
That means you can individually set the levels of your data, coverage, text messages, and call minutes based on your personal preferences. You’ll be able to see the price of your plan as you build it, and there are no surprise fees for activation, overcharges, roaming, or anything else. The price you see is the price you’ll pay, and as long as you stay on that plan, your price will stay the same.
Whatever plan you build, it’s not set in stone. You don’t have to sign a contract or make any other commitment. If things change or you realize you misjudged what you’d need, you can just change the details in a few clicks directly in your account, and your new plan will go into effect when the next payment cycle starts.
You can order a new phone directly through Fizz as well, with options that include iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Motorola, and more. You can pay upfront or split up payments over time, or you can bring your existing phone with you to a Fizz plan. All you have to do is check your phone’s compatibility , order your SIM, customize your plan, and activate your SIM. Or if you don’t want to wait, you can activate an eSIM for free. Fizz also offers refurbished phones as an affordable option that are fully inspected, guaranteed to work, and good for the environment.
If you want to make changes to your plan, that’s all done through your online account too. Just like when you first signed up, you’ll see the price of your altered plan in real time before you finalize, so there’s no surprises on your next bill.
No matter what plan you build or the level of data you choose, unused data doesn’t simply disappear . It automatically rolls over to the next month. Fizz also allows data gifting , so if you realize you’re going to be short on data one month, you can request some from anyone else on the network.
If you’re the generous sort and realize you’re going to have extra, you can gift yours to anyone whose plan includes data. You don’t have to pre-designate friends or family to gift your data to, you can give it to strangers if you want. However, it is important to note that you can’t gift rolled over data, just what is part of your current month’s plan.
Data gifting does more than just give you the satisfaction of knowing you did a good deed, though that part is nice. It also earns you My Rewards points, which is exactly what it sounds like: a rewards program . You can also get points just from signing up for a Fizz account, inviting friends to join, buying a phone, getting add-ons, or any number of other activities.
The more points you accumulate, the more you level up within the loyalty program. This unlocks upgrades and perks, like free mobile data, dollars off your monthly bill, as well as other discounts and benefits.
All in all, Fizz offers a combination of flexibility, customization, and ease of use that’s difficult to match. So if you’re thinking of switching mobile providers and want something that’s tailored to your needs without requiring that you make a long-term commitment, Fizz is worth checking out.
